title: Customer Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 The Domain Architect is responsible for defining and implementing the Core domain\-wide strategy for Application(Cloud network function) deployment automation and AI\-enabled Automation SW development and delivery across various Nokia blueprint as well as customized product teams. The role requires deep expertise in cloud\-native technologies, Network function deployment automation frameworks, CI/CD ecosystems, and the application of AI capabilities to optimize development workstreams, operational efficiency and delivery velocity. The architect will drive scalable, maintainable automation solutions, enable self\-healing delivery pipelines, and mentor teams in modern DevOps and AI\-assisted SW engineering practices.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead requirement analysis, solution alignment, and end\-to\-end architecture activities, including HLD, LLD, CIQ validation and solution governance.
* Define migration strategies, provide technical leadership, and guide implementation activities across the complete migration lifecycle.
* Drive customization discussions, RCA execution, escalation management, and resolution of technical issues in collaboration with Care, R\&D and cross\-functional teams.
* Lead architecture workshops, design reviews, technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and delivery readiness activities to ensure successful solution deployment and adoption.
* Promote innovation through automation, AI\-driven solutions, next\-generation delivery practices, and close collaboration with R\&D/Development team on product enhancements.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, with 10\+ years of experience in architecting software, IT, or telecom solutions.
* Exhibit extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, containerized application deployments.
* Proven experience in defining Cloud\-native architectures and delivering those solutions to the market.
* Experience working effectively in global organizations, with strong communication, motivational and technical leadership skills.
* Prior design and application deployment experience in custom solution and applications products.


 Nice\-to\-Have:
   

  

* Telecom domain exposure (Packet Core, 4G/5G, network protocols, cloud\-native network functions) and Experience in implementing autonomous deployment platforms or AI\-driven operational automation.
* Knowledge of MLOps, AI platform operations and deployment of AI/ML workloads in cloud\-native environments and Certifications in cloud platforms or AI/ML specialties


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
